doc:
I96b's (= I46c, second half) prereg sidecar. The contract is the docstring of tests_m3/test_hints_i96b.py; see BUILD_PLAN row I96b. It fixes the one blind rerun's protocol before anything is built or run, and it holds no outcome. It is I95's protocol (spec/M3/lib/blind_rerun_i95.json) with the lead's rulings for I96 (2026-11-04, 07:08, 11:17 and 11:55): DISCH's r0 from the step (I96a), the refinement hints derived inside the pack, and the declared inputs below.

is the pack commit, a scratch directory outside every checkout, and W the blind session's work directory.

pack.commit: the lead at the commit that lands I96b: the oldest commit of `git rev-list --first-parent --reverse <lead_ref>` whose tree holds holon/refinement.py

scope.base:
python tests_m3/blind_scope.py --commit

--out /scope: I46's six extraction-scope files, stripped by I46's rules

given.why: holon run's records read the ledger's structure; every doc, text and why string is blanked (I46 amendments 3 and 4)
FACT's decider reads I30's budget and measure; the five members it reads (I46 amendment 7)
the binding spec of holon binding: the harness file list, the project, the target and holonDeploy's parameters as a literal list. It is configuration, not a record
harness source (code) that the binding spec names
harness source (code) that the binding spec names
harness source (code) that the binding spec names
the facts copy that the binding spec's parameters read (I95's declared input)
the M1 facts (hand-written from the target's code in M1): the abstract rows and the M1 refinement corpus of holon fragments read them; a declared input (the lead's ruling 11:17, 1)
the M1 model's definitions (win_at and the others the M1 machine compiles); a declared input (11:17, 2)
the M1 model's Lean definitions; a declared input (11:17, 2)
search configuration of the M1 random corpus (harness code: candidate actions from a decoded state); packed after the H1-style leak check with a plant (11:17, 3; 11:55)

the fragments binding's hand-written declarations (abstract, window, its docs and its document); `holon binding --fragments-out` derives replay/M2/fragments.json from it and the binding spec (11:55, Option A)

scope.given_rule:
every given file passes the scope's strip rules (blind_scope.strip with the pack protocol's leak classes at

) with nothing stripped, and stripped.json lists each with its blanked or dropped key paths
scope.never_given: every generated file: the deployment record (gen/M3/binding/, gen/M3/sorts/models/*.init.json), replay/M2/fragments.json (derived by `holon binding --fragments-out`), every other file under replay/ but the harness sources, results/M3/sorts/refinement/ (derived by `holon refinement`), and every result: records, verdicts, witnesses, hints and keys

session.brief: spec/M3/lib/blind_session_i96.md (I96a's and I96b's builds). It is I95's brief with three changes. (1) DISCH's r0 and model_sidecar come from `python -m holon disch-r0 --milestone M3` (I96a). (2) `python -m holon binding --fragments-out --milestone M3` runs after the binding step. (3) `python -m holon refinement --milestone M3` runs after `holon sorts` and before the steps that read the hints
session.launch: a fresh agent session that has never seen an outcome, launched by the coordinator with the brief's text and three paths only: <S>/pack/bundle.tar, <S>/scope and W (a new empty directory outside every checkout)
session.may_read: W, which holds only the unpacked bundle, the scope set, the target fetched at the pinned commit, and what the session itself writes

runners.what: every M3 law of the blind tree that `holon land plan` routes to a job other than par, then the final filter stage
runners.branch: an orphan commit whose tree is W at the session's end, less build/, cache/ and pack/ and less the launch inputs, then CI-only commits: config/holon.json's target paths at the pack's, .github/workflows/.gitkeep, no gitlink (I46 amendments 5 and 6). It is pushed by `holon land plan --tag i96-blind-<k> --push`, and its first commit message starts 'CI only (not for merge)'
runners.apply: `holon land apply --from claude/ci-i95-blind-<k>-out-<run id>` onto a copy of that tree; nothing of the blind tree is edited by hand
runners.local: the blind session runs M3's par job (run, lean, run)

not_run.own: OWN's laws: their search section is the lead's choice of search space (I46 amendment 7c)
not_run.filter_refute: the final filter's refute stage: spec/M3/lib/refute.json holds the lead's statuses and is never given; that stage sets no status

comparison.trees:
the blind tree's projection (`holon compare --snapshot --into audit/blind/I96/tree --milestone M3`) and the lead's at

(`--into audit/blind/I96/lead --milestone M0,M1,M2,M3`)
comparison.metric: `holon compare --blind audit/blind/I96/tree --lead audit/blind/I96/lead --milestone M3 --out audit/blind/I96/compare.json`: I82's blind_agreement and matched_fraction over the statuses of alpha-equivalent statements
comparison.binding_row:
for each typed document, the sha256 of the blind tree's gen/M3/binding/.json against the lead's committed gen/M3/binding/.json at

. An agreement row, reported beside the classes and not counted in blind_agreement
comparison.per_rule: agreement per rule over the matched M3 classes (tests_m3/_i95.py per_rule)
comparison.refinement_rows:
for results/M3/sorts/refinement/hints.json and keys.json, the sha256 of the blind tree's file against the lead's at

, with a field diff when they differ. Agreement rows, reported beside the classes and not counted in blind_agreement
comparison.r0_row: I96a's row (tests_m3/_i96a.py r0_row): the blind DISCH sidecar's r0 and model_sidecar against the lead's at

scorers.amended: tests_m3/_i46_reads.py::reads_problems, preregistered on this key before the session

exit.E1: the comparison regenerates: `holon report --milestone M3 --check` prints REPORT OK on the final head
exit.E2: blind_agreement on M3 >= 0.90 over at least 40 matched M3 classes, in I96's comparison
exit.E3:
results/M3/audit_status.json at

has converged = true (I45's exit)
exit.E4:
results/M3/backtest.json at

lists no exit blocker (I24)
exit.E5: the reads check passes, reported under both scorers
exit.m3_exit: E1 and E2 and E3 and E4 and E5

fallback: only if forge cannot run in the blind environment: the generated inputs become declared inputs with their sha256 and their generating commands, disclosed as unreproduced and excluded from the agreement count, and E2 is reported both ways
